title: The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle
creator: Haruki Murakami
summary: A man searches for his missing cat. Then his missing wife. Then something harder to name.
personalNote: The most Murakami of all Murakami books — which is either a recommendation or a warning depending on you. Reality dissolves slowly enough that you don't notice until you're already in the well. The war sections hit like cold water. I've thought about the man at the bottom of the dry well more than once since.
